records.note: Pasted with its item details in a review on TrackingMore's Kenya Post page. Posta Kenya's tracker shows the item posted in Kenya, sent through the office of exchange and delivered in Sweden.

Quoted as an undelivered package in a review on TrackingMore's Kenya Post page. Posta Kenya's tracker shows the EMS item posted in Kenya, a failed delivery attempt and its delivery in the United States.

Quoted, with a space, as an item not yet received in a review on TrackingMore's Kenya Post page. Posta Kenya's tracker shows the item posted in Kenya, through customs in Ukraine, and a failed delivery attempt there.
Quoted as a missing mail item in a review on TrackingMore's Kenya Post page. Posta Kenya's tracker shows the item posted in Kenya and received at the office of exchange, with no scan after it.

Quoted as a parcel sent from South Africa to Kenya in a review on TrackingMore's Kenya Post page. Posta Kenya's tracker shows the South African post's scans, then its own at the office of exchange in Nairobi and onward to Mombasa.
